title: Transfer - ExpressRoute Gateway Failover Leak Review
goal: Evaluate a hybrid ExpressRoute-plus-VPN failover incident, detect whether backup path preferences create instability or leak upstream routes into branch peers, and judge candidate remediations under Azure-managed gateway constraints.
skillBenefitRationale: The scenario shifts from Virtual WAN hub peering to hybrid gateway failover, yet the same azure-bgp expertise remains uniquely necessary: managed-control-plane limits, oscillation detection, valley-free policy checks, and allowed routing-policy mitigations.
